title: Comment: What sustainable finance can learn from AI calls for regulation
lede: Finance should follow AI industry in making clear policy asks as climate change threats grow, writes Steve Waygood.

title: ICCR to push firms to adopt resolution rules after SEC shift
lede: Investor letter will call on US corporates to adopt policies allowing acceptance of shareholder resolutions if Rule 14a-8 is rescinded.

title: Brussels is moving to ban street advertising by fossil-fuel firms – the EU officials who live there should take note
lede: Five Brussels municipalities, home to nearly one-in-three of the city's residents, have now voted to drive fossil-fuel advertising off their streets. In the city where Europe's climate laws are written, the industry's grip on billboards and on lawmakers has to be broken together.
